body: You own U21. You and Codex independently named the same casualty - BroadcastRead assumes 14 seconds per event - so it gets fixed BEFORE the core, not during it. You wrote U19, so you own its one hardcoded assumption. Read a per-event span when present, fall back to 14.0 when absent. THE TRAP IS THE FALLBACK: a change that makes real-time logs right while silently shifting today's numbers is a regression, because the atomic engine ships until R82 lands - write the no-span-field regression assertion FIRST, it is the gate. If C63 has not landed, inline the division exactly as TASK_C63 specifies and say so; Claude reconciles. Branch as usual and name the branch in your mail. Suite 194/0.
